backfillRows.why: spell-2062 prints "You can make wind crash unarmed Strikes as RANGED Strikes against targets within 30 feet", and every stance Strike was derived through deriveUnarmedStrike with no range at all — a melee, Strength-keyed attack. StanceStrike gained the `range` carrier in this batch (src/rules/types.ts, passed through at src/rules/derive.ts's stance-strike profile, which already handled `range` for the Spined Azarketi's spine), so the printed 30 feet is now expressible. This re-emits the WHOLE `strikes` array — the same single strike work/.b031-rows-data-rows.json's create row authors, plus `range: 30`.

findings.note: ORDER-DEPENDENT, deliberately: this is a FIELD row on stances/wild-winds-stance, which work/.b031-rows-data-rows.json CREATES. The manifest lists that spec before this one and the driver replays the overlay after each spec, so the record exists by the time this row is applied. It is a separate row rather than an edit of the other family's spec because an agent may not rewrite another agent's file, and a second create row on the same id would be refused as a collision. The clinging-shadows-stance def needs no such row — its shadow grasp Strike is melee (agile/grapple/reach/unarmed) and derives correctly as authored.
